scripts.build:firefox: npm run clean && cp -r src dist-firefox && cp manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist-firefox/
scripts.build:chromium: npm run clean && cp -r src dist-chromium && cp manifest.chromium.json dist-chromium/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist-chromium/
scripts.build:windows:firefox: npm run clean:windows && xcopy src dist-firefox\ /E /I && copy manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox\manifest.json && xcopy icons dist-firefox\icons\ /E /I
scripts.build:windows:chromium: npm run clean:windows && xcopy src dist-chromium\ /E /I && copy manifest.chromium.json dist-chromium\manifest.json && xcopy icons dist-chromium\icons\ /E /I
scripts.clean:windows: if exist dist-firefox rmdir /s /q dist-firefox && if exist dist-chromium rmdir /s /q dist-chromium
scripts.package:windows: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist-firefox\* -DestinationPath eq12-firefox-ext.zip -Force; Compress-Archive -Path dist-chromium\* -DestinationPath eq12-chromium-ext.zip -Force"
